<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Record page 3 column layout">426a984e79c0df54c34eb56e1a47c582</macroponent><name>Multitask Selector - On Search Input</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    if (event.name === 'NOW_INPUT#INPUT') {
        var searchInput = event.payload.fieldValue;
        api.setState('searchTerms', searchInput);
    } else if (event.name === 'NOW_DROPDOWN#ITEM_CLICKED') {
        var filter = event.payload.item.id;
        api.setState('searchFilters', filter);
        if (api.state.searchTerms != null && api.state.searchTerms.trim().length > 0)
            api.setState('isSearchLoading', true);
    } else if (event.name === 'NOW_BUTTON#CLICKED') {
        var searchInput = api.state.searchTerms;
        if (searchInput.trim().length > 0) {
            if (api.state.searchFilters != null && api.state.searchFilters.trim().length > 0)
                api.setState('isSearchLoading', true);
        } else {
            api.setState('searchResult', {
                rows: []
            });
        }
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>felipe.valenca</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-21 16:26:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>2e6ad84e79c0df54c34eb56e1a47c58d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Multitask Selector - On Search Input</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Escola Virtual" source="x_fub_fundbrad_ev">e56ecca5ecff031463f173bdfd6dd941</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Escola Virtual">e56ecca5ecff031463f173bdfd6dd941</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_2e6ad84e79c0df54c34eb56e1a47c58d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>felipe.valenca</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-21 16:26:42</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
